title: All of Me (Bossa)
style: English, bossa nova, warm intimate male baritone vocal, nylon-string guitar, brushed drums, upright bass and Fender Rhodes, intimate tender mellow, intimate close-mic production, 125 BPM
lyrics:
[Intro]
The fan clicks once
You hum, slicing an orange
Juice runs down your wrist
I'm already home

[Verse 1]
I'm not the man from your notebook pages
No grand piano, no tall windows
I burn the rice, I lose the keys
I say the wrong thing every time
But I will sit on this kitchen floor
Till the sun finds your shoulder
Learning the shape of you in my hands

[Pre-Chorus]
Coffee gone cold in the chipped blue mug
I'd drink every sip, every bitter one
I'm not the calm you imagined
But I'm here, and I'm staying

[Chorus]
All of me
Even the parts I can't fix
The mornings I oversleep
The promises I haven't kept
I give you the mess and the making
Every crooked, stubborn inch
All of me

[Verse 2]
Last Tuesday, fire escape, me yelling at a cab
Hair in my eyes, heart in my throat
You tugged me back inside, sat me on the rug
Cold can to my neck, said nothing
Just stayed until the shouting stopped
I've never been more seen

[Chorus]
All of me
Even the parts I can't fix
The mornings I oversleep
The promises I haven't kept
I give you the mess and the making
Every crooked, stubborn inch
All of me

[Bridge]
Your scar's from a bicycle in Lisbon
Mine's from the night I tried to cook
We fit like that — not clean, but true
I don't want the polished version
I want the one who knows your middle name
And how you take your tea when no one's watching

[Outro]
The fan clicks off
You're asleep, orange on your breath
I stay right here
All of me
Even the quiet
cover_prompt: warm intimate bossa nova, kitchen at dusk, orange slices, soft golden light, 9:16 vertical
